title: Associate Technical Consultant-HRMS
description:
Job Description

**Position: Junior .NET Developer**

**Experience:** 0–1 Years
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology**, or **MCA**.
* Freshers and candidates with up to 1 year of relevant experience are eligible to apply.

**Required Skills**

* Basic to good knowledge of **C# and .NET Framework/.NET**.
* Strong understanding of **Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs)** concepts.
* Working knowledge of **MS SQL Server** and SQL queries.
* Basic knowledge of **Reporting Services**.
* Basic understanding of **Web APIs/REST APIs**.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and development frameworks.

**Good to Have**

* Basic knowledge of **application deployment, IIS, and deployment services**.
* Basic knowledge of **Angular** or other front-end frameworks.
* Basic awareness of **Generative AI and Agentic AI** concepts.
* Basic understanding of **Git and version control**.
* Familiarity with **API integration** will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using C# and .NET.
* Write, execute, and optimize SQL queries.
* Develop, integrate, and consume Web APIs/REST APIs.
* Debug applications and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Participate in application testing, debugging, and issue resolution.
* Assist with application deployment and production support activities.
* Work closely with senior developers to implement new features and enhancements.
* Follow established coding standards, development practices, and version-control processes.
* Continuously learn and adopt modern technologies, including Angular/React, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Junior .NET Developer with a strong foundation in programming and a willingness to learn and grow.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of C#, OOPs, SQL, and .NET, along with an interest in application development, reporting, APIs, deployment, and emerging AI technologies.

The candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong logical and analytical thinking.
* Good problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and explore new technologies.
* A proactive approach toward understanding technical challenges and finding solutions.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Core Skills:** C# | .NET | OOPs | MS SQL Server | SQL | Web API/REST API | Reporting Services

**Good to Have:** Angular/React | IIS | Application Deployment | Git | API Integration | Generative AI | Agentic AI

title: Academy BPO Team Lead
description:
Job summary
  
Seeking a Senior Flutter App Developer with strong expertise in Flutter Dart and mobile architecture patterns (MVVM MVC Clean Architecture). Responsible for developing high\-performance iOS and Android applications integrating REST/GraphQL APIs implementing state management solutions and ensuring code quality through testing and reviews. Must possess strong debugging collaboration and problem\-solving skills.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
1\. Proven experience developing applications with Flutter and Dart
  
2\. Strong understanding of mobile app architecture patterns (MVVM MVC Clean Architecture)
  
3\. Familiarity with RESTful APIs JSON and third\-party integrations
  
4\. Understanding of app store submission processes and guidelines
  
5\. Design and build advanced applications for iOS and Android using the Flutter framework
  
6\. Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into high\-quality responsive code
  
7\. Write clean maintainable and well\-documented Dart code
  
8\. Integrate RESTful APIs GraphQL and third\-party libraries/SDKs
  
9\. Ensure the performance quality and responsiveness of applications
  
10\. Identify and fix bugs bottlenecks and performance issues
  
11\. Implement state management solutions (Provider Riverpod BLoC GetX etc.)
  
12\. Collaborate with backend developers to define and integrate APIs
  
13\. Write unit widget and integration tests to ensure code quality
  
14\. Maintain code quality through code reviews and adherence to best practices
  
15\. Stay up to date with the latest industry trends tools and Flutter/Dart updates
  
16\. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (design QA product) throughout the development lifecycle
  
17\. Ability to work independently and manage time effectively
  
18\. Good communication and collaboration abilities
  
19\. Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills
  
20\. Attention to detail and commitment to code quality
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Google Associate Android Developer or equivalent Flutter certification from a recognized provider is preferred
